solutions.title: Shift and use symmetry
solutions.body:
Substitute $t=x-5$: $\int_{-5}^5\left(t+t^2+t^3\right)dt$. The odd terms $t$ and $t^3$ integrate to $0$ over a symmetric interval, leaving $\int_{-5}^5t^2dt=\frac{2\cdot125}{3}=\frac{250}3$.

**Answer: $\frac{250}{3}$**

prompt: Water is flowing out through the smaller base of a hollow conical frustum formed by taking a downwards pointing cone of radius $12$ m and slicing off the tip of the cone in a cut parallel to the base so that the radius of the cross-section of the slice is $6$ m (meaning the smaller base has a radius of $6$ m). The height of the frustum is $10$ m. If the height of the water level in the frustum is decreasing at $3$ m/s and the current height is $5$ m, then the volume of the water in the frustum is decreasing at $d$ m$^3$/s. Compute $d$.

solutions.title: Related rates
solutions.body:
The radius of the frustum grows linearly from $6$ at the bottom to $12$ at the top over height $10$, so at water height $h$ the surface radius is $r(h)=6+\frac{6}{10}h$. At $h=5$, $r=9$.

The water volume satisfies $\frac{dV}{dh}=\pi r(h)^2$ (the area of the surface). So $\left|\frac{dV}{dt}\right|=\pi\cdot81\cdot3=243\pi$.

**Answer: $d=243\pi$**

solutions.title: Fold the integral
solutions.body:
Split at $0$ and substitute $x\to-x$ on $[-\pi,0]$, where $|x|=-x$: $I=\int_0^\pi\frac{e^{x^2}-e^{-x^2}}{e^{x^2}+x\sqrt2}\,x\,dx+\int_0^\pi\frac{e^{x^2}-e^{-x^2}}{e^{x^2}-x\sqrt2}\,x\,dx$.

Combining over the common denominator $e^{2x^2}-2x^2$: $I=\int_0^\pi\frac{\left(e^{x^2}-e^{-x^2}\right)\cdot2e^{x^2}\,x}{e^{2x^2}-2x^2}dx=\int_0^\pi\frac{(2e^{2x^2}-2)x}{e^{2x^2}-2x^2}dx$.

With $v=e^{2x^2}-2x^2$, $dv=\left(4xe^{2x^2}-4x\right)dx$, so the integrand is $\frac{dv}{2v}$. Thus $I=\frac12\ln v\Big|_{x=0}^{x=\pi}=\frac12\ln\left(e^{2\pi^2}-2\pi^2\right)-\frac12\ln1$.

**Answer: $\frac12\ln\left(e^{2\pi^2}-2\pi^2\right)$**
